prompt: Listen to the story: Text A argues that children spend far too much time in front of screens, and it says that screen time should be limited so kids stay healthy and active. Text B: "Some farmers say honeybees do not mean to help. Bees only visit flowers to feed themselves. But while they eat, pollen rubs off onto other flowers by accident, so the crops grow better whether the bees mean to help or not."

Both texts agree that bees move pollen between flowers. What do they DISAGREE about?
choices: Whether the bees move pollen on purpose or by accident
Whether bees drink nectar from flowers
Whether bees actually touch pollen at all
Whether pollen helps new plants grow
correct: Whether the bees move pollen on purpose or by accident
